name: Proto Lugia
look: a gaunt dark violet Lugia with a lilac plated belly, bone spikes along its back, flanks and tail, and great wings of four feathered fingers tipped with bone-white claws
entry: A Pokémon resembling Lugia, described in an old sailor's log about a spined dragon that rose from the deep before a storm. Its claws are said to be able to tear a ship's hull in two.
how: Wild: very rare at night over deep oceans.
